BiblicalUsage: Mânôwach is Manoah, the Danite of Zorah whose wife was barren until the angel came. In Judges 13:2 Manoah is named, and in Judges 13:8 he prays for the man of God to come again and teach them what to do with the child to be born. In Judges 16:31 Samson is buried in the burying place of Manoah his father., and his name belongs to a father who prayed before his son was born.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mânôwach shows me a father who prayed first and acted second, and I hold that Manoah's prayer is a pattern for every parent waiting on God.
